strings.MNT_new_absolutism_desc: According to Montenegrin law, the current king, a Romanov prince the Italians offered the crown to, governs with near absolute power, being leader of the legislative and executive branches and being able to appoint judges at will. The king also significantly controls the Central Corporative Council, a corporatist-esque committee that manages the Montenegrin economy.
strings.MNT_durisic_chetniks_desc: The only proper military force of Montenegro is the Montenegrin National Army, led by renegade chetnik Pavle Djurišić. Hardly proper soldiers, they spend as much time fighting the partisans as they do burning and looting the villages they're supposed to protect. However, keeping them satisfied is vital to prevent them from turning against the kingdom.
strings.MNT_unending_unrest_desc: Montenegro has been locked in a cycle of periodic insurgency and repression since WW2. The local antifascist movement, CASNO, has a strong and well organized partisan movement using the mountains and the forests of the country to its advantage, and it is helped and supplied by the other Yugoslav liberation movements.
